verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with OpenAPI spec, authentication, and parameters ('Integrate through HTTP', OpenAPI specification), and a live openapi.json endpoint was confirmed via probe, plus a CLI for operating an instance from a terminal. This gives AI-native users a documented, machine-consumable interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of API usage in practice, and more detail on rate limits/versioning guarantees.
